description: The proposal and roadmap protocol of a company (the company-proposals plugin must be installed on the Project), as one skill with a section per role any employee takes — no dedicated hires: the author who writes a short, abstract proposal a person comments on passage by passage and revises it on feedback; the implementer who builds it at the same time on a proposal branch, opens the PR against dev and reports back; the tester who runs the dev branch in batches; and the roadmap member and moderator who turn a room's discussion into approved items. The plugin installs it on whoever writes or builds a proposal.
description_zh: 公司提案与路线图的协议（Project 须先装上 company-proposals 插件），合为一个 Skill，按角色分节，任何员工都照做——不设专门岗位：作者写一份短小、抽象、可逐段评论的提案并按反馈修订；实施者同时在提案分支上实施、向 dev 开 PR 并反馈；测试者分批测试 dev 分支；路线图成员与主持人把讨论室的讨论变成获批的条目。插件会自动装到写或做提案的员工上。
short_description: The proposal and roadmap protocol for company mode: write, build, test, plan — any employee.
short_description_zh: 公司模式的提案与路线图协议：写、做、测、规划——任何员工都可以。

quick_start.prompt: Explain how a proposal moves through this organization — who may start one, how the author builds it or hands the build to a colleague, how a person comments and approves — and show the penguin org proposal commands at each step.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 说明一份提案在这个组织里怎么流转——谁可以发起、作者怎么自己实施或交给同事、人怎么评论与认可——并给出每一步要用的 penguin org proposal 命令。
